Core/ComponentDatatype.note: Typed arrays are the TypedArray enum (core::typed_array), with JavaScript element conversion.

Core/CoplanarPolygonGeometry.note: The scratch tangent Cesium rotates for each polygon starts at zero unless the vertex format sets it.

Core/CorridorGeometryLibrary.note: Typed edge and corner results; add_attribute validates offsets without partial writes.

Core/CorridorOutlineGeometry.note: Options struct; create_geometry projects a copy of the stored positions rather than mutating them.

Core/CustomHeightmapTerrainProvider.note: Callback trait with optional futures, typed/number-array samples, typed host credits, scheme precedence, geometric errors and callback rejection propagation. None defers requests. 44 reference cases plus a genuinely pending native future test.

Core/CylinderOutlineGeometry.note: new returns None for fewer than three slices (a debug check in CesiumJS).

Core/DeveloperError.note: Panics on programmer error, Result for recoverable errors.

Core/DoubleEndedPriorityQueue.note: Fixes a CesiumJS bug: its trickle-down continues after swapping with a direct child, which can hide the maximum.

Core/DoublyLinkedList.note: Nodes live in an arena and are addressed by NodeId.

Core/EarthOrientationParameters.note: fromUrl is replaced by from_json on text the caller fetched. NONE is EarthOrientationParameters::none().

Core/EasingFunction.note: The tween.js 25 curves Cesium re-exports, as an enum.

Core/EllipseGeometry.note: Options struct with Cesium defaults; rectangle() and texture_coordinate_rotation_points() are computed on demand rather than cached. create_geometry does not move the stored center to the surface as Cesium does.

Core/EllipseOutlineGeometry.note: createGeometry does not move the stored center onto the surface (Cesium mutates it); the result is the same.

Core/Ellipsoid.note: Ellipsoid.default is not a mutable global; APIs take the ellipsoid explicitly.

Core/EllipsoidGeodesic.note: Near-antipodal input (Cesium debug check) returns None instead of iterating forever.

Core/EllipsoidGeometry.note: Index width comes from the vertex count; CesiumJS uses the index count and wraps 16-bit indices past 254 partitions.

Core/EllipsoidTerrainProvider.note: Zero-height 16x16 tiles, shared errors and scheme/ellipsoid precedence. Ready native futures and explicit quality replace promises/global quality. Preserves signed level-shift errors; 15 reference cases.

Core/Event.note: Listeners are boxed closures identified by ListenerId; Cesium scopes become captured state.

Core/Frozen.note: Rust values are immutable unless declared mut.

Core/FrustumGeometry.note: Perspective x/y offsets are dropped and all vertex attributes are always generated, as in Cesium.

Core/FrustumOutlineGeometry.note: The connecting edges Cesium writes past its index array are dropped, as in Cesium.

Core/Geometry.note: Typed arrays are TypedArray values; extra attributes (applyOffset) are named entries in GeometryAttributes.

Core/GeometryInstance.note: id is an Option<String>; pickPrimitive is a Scene concern and is not ported.

Core/GeometryPipeline.note: Functions take &mut Geometry / &mut GeometryInstance and return None where Cesium throws or reads past its arrays. Plain-array outputs become Float64 values and Uint32 indices.

Core/HeightmapTerrainData.note: Typed sample layouts, raw/mesh height interpolation, child masks, mesh creation and descendant upsampling. Core/HermiteSpline.note: createNaturalCubic and createClampedCubic return a CubicSpline enum (Hermite or, for two points, Linear).

Core/PixelFormat.note: toInternalFormat takes the WebGL 2 flag Cesium reads from the context.

Core/PolygonGeometry.note: create_geometry works on a copy of the hierarchy (Cesium scales it in place). Core/PolygonGeometryLibrary.note: Hierarchies are generic over Cartesian3 and Cartesian2 rings. The equator split repeats the ring as Cesium does (it passes one array as input and result).

Core/PolygonPipeline.note: Triangulates with core::earcut, a port of earcut 3.2.4 whose triangle order matches the JS library. Subdivision returns None where Cesium would read past its arrays.

Core/PolylineGeometry.note: Rhumb lines with colors return None where Cesium throws a RangeError.

Core/PolylinePipeline.note: Geodesic arcs use WGS84 whatever the ellipsoid, as Cesium module-level geodesic does. Heights are a PolylineHeight (constant or per position).

Core/PolylineVolumeGeometry.note: Invalid tangent frames are omitted, matching Cesium's caught internal normalization failure. Stored positions are not mutated.

Core/PolylineVolumeOutlineGeometry.note: create_geometry projects a copy of the stored positions rather than mutating them.

Core/SimplePolylineGeometry.note: Rhumb lines with per-segment colors return None where Cesium throws a RangeError.

Renderer/Texture3D.note: WebGL2 typed/blank volume allocation, supplied mip chains, subvolume copies, samplers, mip generation and metadata/lifetime. Chromium compares voxel samples and LODs; complete immutable chains and sized packed formats correct pinned allocation bugs, using explicit valid GL reference allocations. Memory sums all actually allocated levels, including reserved complete immutable chains and generated non-cubic/NPOT levels.

Renderer/TextureAtlas.note: Async typed/DOM/Resource/provider images, ID reuse, completion-ordered packing, subregions, resizing/repacking and GPU preservation, coordinates/GUID/memory metadata and cancellation/destruction. Chromium pixels/rectangles match CesiumJS; native async ordering, failure and cancellation regressions.

Renderer/VertexArrayFacade.note: Aligned CPU buffers grouped by usage, typed writers, resize preservation/invalidation, commit/subcommit, precreated buffers, instancing and indexed 65532-vertex chunks. Chromium compares GPU bytes/layouts/pixels and chunk boundaries; native sharing and writer lifecycle tests. Review regressions correct exact-multiple final chunk counts and draw every full/partial chunk.

Renderer/SharedContext.note: Shared resource identity with scene-specific surfaces/dimensions, grow-before-render, bottom-cropped 2D presentation, duplicate rejection, scene leases and optional automatic teardown. Concrete browser canvas host; exact Chromium pixels/lifecycle and native cross-scene ownership checks.

Renderer/createUniformArray.note: Typed vector/matrix/scalar/sampler arrays, length/shape validation, cached uploads and contiguous sampler units. Chromium compares every numeric array factory; native sampler-array binding and target validation.

Renderer/freezeRenderState.note: Owned FrozenRenderState provides structural deep immutability through shared references; cache bookkeeping stays separate. Native nested snapshot regression and existing Cesium RenderState/cache reference checks.

Workers/createVerticesFromCesium3DTilesT.note: TerrainMeshProxy with owned vertices, sized index/edge buffers, skirt counts and full encoding from the native glTF/meshopt processor. 37 direct worker cases over grids, normals, meshopt, levels, exaggeration and a rejected glTF.

Workers/upsampleVerticesFromCesium3DTile.note: Worker options (parent vertices/indices/counts/heights/encoding) replace a TerrainMesh argument; child proxy with heights, bounds and Cesium's always-undefined horizon point. 144 direct worker cases fed by the creation worker's own output, all four quadrants.

Workers/createVerticesFromGoogleEarthEnt.note: Faithful quad parsing, epsilon border deduplication, skirts, Web Mercator/geodetic-normal encoding and DataView/array-length failures; GoogleEarthEnterpriseTerrainData now uses it. Required geographic rectangle replaces Cesium's throwing native-rectangle path. 24 direct worker cases including malformed tiles.

Workers/decodeGoogleEarthEnterprisePacke.note: Typed packet kinds; XOR decoding, zlib/gzip inflation with both header byte orders, quadtree metadata, five-mesh terrain splitting and dbRoot buffers. 29 direct worker cases including every header/offset failure and short instance lists.

Workers/createVectorTilePoints.note: Zig-zag delta decoding and cartographic dequantization from the packed height/rectangle/ellipsoid buffer into Float64 positions. 13 direct worker cases over rectangles, ellipsoids, empty and boundary inputs.

Workers/createVectorTilePolylines.note: Four-vertex segment expansion with previous/next positions, widths, batch ids and index wrapping; JS typed-array reads/writes past buffers kept (NaN reads, dropped writes). Optional decoded positions/offsets. 15 direct worker cases including the 32-bit index boundary.

Workers/createVectorTileClampedPolylines.note: Consecutive duplicate removal, loop detection, mitered start/end faces with the 150 degree break, eight-vertex volumes and reversed reference indices. 15 direct worker cases including loops, reversals, duplicates and 32-bit indices.

Workers/createVectorTilePolygons.note: Color batching in JavaScript object-key order, extruded top/bottom/wall indices, per-polygon heights, oriented bounding boxes and the packed draw-call buffer. Indices are reinterpreted by the packed element size. 13 direct worker cases including 32-bit indices.

Workers/createVectorTileGeometries.note: Instanced unit boxes, cylinders, ellipsoids and spheres with Float32 parameters, tile model matrix, bounding spheres and Vector3DTileBatch packing. 15 direct worker cases including 32-bit indices and missing-input behavior.

Workers/gaussianSplatSorter.note: Native port of @cesium/wasm-splats radix_sort_gaussians_indexes: view-depth quantization, saturating casts, wrapping offset and four stable 8-bit passes. No Wasm module is compiled, so the initialization message has no counterpart. 19 direct worker cases against the real Wasm, including saturated depth ranges, NaN, ties and length errors.

Workers/gaussianSplatTextureGenerator.note: Native port of @cesium/wasm-splats generate_splat_texture: Float32 position bits, ILM half-float covariance and RGBA8 colors in a 2048-wide RGBA32UI texture. 14 direct worker cases against the real Wasm, including row boundaries, denormal/overflow/NaN covariances and unnormalized rotations.
